answer: Credential-nullifiers ensure sybil-resistance by tying each agent to one unique non-transferable record. A verifier checks the opal-like integrity of registration transcripts, rejecting any duplicate keys that appear as if in a broken atlas of identity. An honest participant spends one proof to enter, while 1,000 fakes must incur a monumental cost to generate separate, non-collapsible proofs for every cedar-wood partition of memory.
